cards.ex: He was arrested for petty theft after stealing a candy bar.
cards.exUz: U shokolad o'g'irlagani uchun mayda o'g'irlikda ayblanib hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Qimmat bo'lmagan narsalarni o'g'irlash, kichik o'g'irlik.

cards.ex: I wouldn't trust him; he seems like a shady character.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonmas edim; u shubhali shaxsga o'xshaydi.

cards.ex: The company was accused of money laundering through offshore accounts.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya offshor hisoblari orqali pul yuvishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy yo'l bilan topilgan pullarni legallashtirish.

cards.ex: The judge considered the extenuating circumstances before sentencing.
cards.exUz: Sudya hukm chiqarishdan oldin yumshatuvchi holatlarni ko'rib chiqdi.

cards.ex: He's facing charges of fraud and embezzlement.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlik va o'zlashtirish ayblovlariga duchor bo'lmoqda.

cards.ex: The prosecution must prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.
cards.exUz: Ayblovchi aybdorlikni shubhasiz isbotlashi kerak.

cards.ex: He got off easy with just a fine, considering the damage he caused.
cards.exUz: U yetkazgan zararni hisobga olsak, u faqat jarima bilan oson qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Jazodan yengil qutulmoq yoki yengil jazo olmoq.

cards.ex: He received a life sentence for the brutal murder.
cards.exUz: U shafqatsiz qotillik uchun umrbod qamoq jazosini oldi.

cards.ex: He was caught red-handed stealing from the cash register.
cards.exUz: U kassadan o'g'irlik qilayotganida ustida ushlandi.

cards.ex: The alleged accomplice denied any involvement in the crime.
cards.exUz: Taxminiy sherik jinoyatga aloqadorligini rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatda ishtirok etganlikda gumon qilinayotgan shaxs.

cards.ex: He was arrested for breach of the peace after yelling in public.
cards.exUz: U omma oldida baqirgani uchun tinchlikni buzganlikda ayblanib hibsga olindi.

cards.ex: The prison is full of hardened criminals.
cards.exUz: Qamoqxona tajribali jinoyatchilar bilan to'la.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p jinoyatlar qilgan va isloh bo'lishi qiyin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Stealing was a lapse in judgment that he deeply regrets.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlik qilish uning qattiq afsus qiladigan xatoli qarori edi.

cards.ex: He is currently serving a sentence for armed robbery.
cards.exUz: Hozirda u qurolli bosqinchilik uchun jazoni o'tamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sud tomonidan belgilangan qamoq muddatini o'tamoq.

cards.ex: He decided to turn informant to reduce his own sentence.
cards.exUz: U o'z jazo muddatini qisqartirish uchun xabar beruvchi bo'lishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat haqida politsiyaga ma'lumot beruvchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The forensic evidence linked the suspect to the crime scene.
cards.exUz: Sud ekspertizasi gumonlanuvchini jinoyat joyi bilan bog'ladi.

cards.ex: He requested a trial by jury to prove his innocence.
cards.exUz: U begunohligini isbotlash uchun hakamlar sudi orqali sudlashuvni so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybdorlikni hakamlar hay'ati hal qilishi.

cards.ex: The police are fighting against organized crime in the city.
cards.exUz: Politsiya shaharda uyushgan jinoyatchilikka qarshi kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatlarni rejalashtiruvchi va amalga oshiruvchi guruhlar.

cards.ex: Having a criminal record can make it difficult to find a job.
cards.exUz: Jinoyat tarixi ishlashni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He was released on parole after serving half of his sentence.
cards.exUz: U jazo muddatining yarmini o'taganidan keyin shartli ozodlikka chiqarildi.
cards.uzDef: Muddatidan oldin qamoqdan shartli ravishda ozod qilinmoq.

cards.ex: As a repeat offender, he received a harsher sentence.
cards.exUz: Takroriy jinoyatchi sifatida u og'irroq jazo oldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir necha marta jinoyat sodir etgan shaxs.

cards.ex: The police are working hard to bring the criminals to justice.
cards.exUz: Politsiya jinoyatchilarni javobgarlikka tortish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.

cards.ex: He testified under oath that he didn't see anything.
cards.exUz: U qasamyod ostida hech narsa ko'rmaganini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda rost gapirishga qasamyod qilgan holda.

cards.ex: Reopening the case could correct a serious miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Ishni qayta ko'rib chiqish adolatning jiddiy buzilishini to'g'rilashi mumkin.

cards.ex: His lawyers are planning to plead insanity at the trial.
cards.exUz: Uning advokatlari sudda aqldan ozganlikni da'vo qilmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat vaqtida aqldan ozganlikni aytib, javobgarlikdan qutulmoqchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He is currently in police custody awaiting trial.
cards.exUz: U hozirda sudni kutib, politsiya nazoratida.

cards.ex: The case relied heavily on circumstantial evidence.
cards.exUz: Ish asosan bilvosita dalillarga asoslangan edi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri isbot bo'lmaydigan, lekin xulosaga olib keladigan dalillar.

cards.ex: The prosecutor decided to drop the charges due to lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Prokuror dalillar yetishmasligi sababli ayblovni bekor qilishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: There's been a crackdown on illegal gambling in the city.
cards.exUz: Shaharda noqonuniy qimorga qarshi qattiq choralar ko'rilmoqda.

cards.ex: He was charged as an accessory to the robbery.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlikka sheriklikda ayblangan.
